<translate>
<!--T:9-->
'''Dimensional Warp''' is an evasion technique that teleports you behind your locked-on target, even from far away. It is one of the rewards of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Janemba|Janemba]] world boss, and its short cooldown makes it one of the most mobile techniques in the game.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
No master teaches Dimensional Warp by default. It has a '''20%''' chance to drop from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Janemba|Janemba]] world boss (the server default; see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]). Server owners can also add it to a master's list, where it costs '''12,000 TP''', and admins can grant it with {{Command|/dmztech add}}.

<!--T:12-->
Like every evasion technique, it needs [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and it must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
* '''With a locked-on target within 64 blocks''', you teleport right behind it.
* '''Without a target''', you teleport a few blocks forward.

<!--T:15-->
Lock on with {{Key|Z}}; your lock-on range depends on [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]]. After using it, all your evasion techniques share a short lockout (the technique's duration + 3 seconds).
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades == <!--T:16-->

<!--T:17-->
Dimensional Warp gains experience every time you use it. Spend it in the Skills menu on '''duration''' (+2.5% per level, up to +50%) and '''cooldown'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Afterimage|Afterimage]] works in a similar way, but only reaches targets within 24 blocks.
</translate>
